faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment in 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for selecting qualified candidates for temporary research positions based in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position in this recruitment notification released by the esteemed Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The final date to submit your online application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 2 October 2026. Ensure you submit well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Food Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or allied fields with relevant background.

faq.question: Q5. Are candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis eligible?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have successfully submitted their Ph.D. thesis are also fully eligible to apply for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position will receive a monthly salary ranging from ₹72,000/- to ₹84,000/- depending on their qualifications and experience profile.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Gandhinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the designated project staff recruitment portal of IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Gandhinagar for this particular Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the online application portal through the official IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment website at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ before the closing date.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of research experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Preferred research experience includes work in slippery surfaces, superhydrophobic surfaces, thermodynamic stability, surface science, wet chemical techniques, materials characterizations, and journal publication writing.
